forum.title: About STM32WBA25 series PCB antenna
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi,

Yes, it is possible to replace the IPD with discrete components in the RF path.

You can have a look at application note [AN5948](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5948-how-to-develop-rf-hardware-using-stm32wba5xxx-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf); you should find what you need there.

For now, it does not include the WBA2, but a new version will be released in the coming weeks

BR, Joé
forum.content_text:
Hi :

I’ve been working on planning an STM32WBA25 series product recently. Regarding the antenna design, I’ve been referencing ST’s development board “NUCLEO-WBA25CE1.” From the MCU pin, the signal goes through an IPD, then a matching network, and finally to the antenna.

Currently, the IPD is a major challenge for me. Is it possible to replace the IPD with discrete components?
forum.author: CY_Tsai
